title: dedicated-fleet-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-v21
author: Liam Chen
description: Motivation: Improve Dedicated fleet autoscaler visibility and make burst controls first-class for SLO-driven routing and billing. This PR adds a per-fleet burst utilization report, exposes new autoscaling policy knobs (burst_budget, sustained_util_target, cooldown_window), and wires metrics into the Console and telemetry pipeline. Changes include scheduler-level enforcement of burst_budget to protect latency SLOs while allowing short-term throughput spikes, new Prometheus metrics and derived Grafana dashboards, API endpoints for querying historical burst consumption, and a migration to persist burst state in the fleet state store. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-2129) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Load testing in perf-canary - [x] Console dashboard wiring - [x] Backwards-compatible schema migration Summary of approach: Implemented burst_budget as a per-fleet token bucket consumed by requests routed through the fleet autoscaler. When burst_budget is depleted the autoscaler will fallback to sustained capacity scaling and optionally re-route to spillover fleets per policy. Added sustained_util_target which allows SREs to set a non-binary target for the sustained portion of capacity. Added cooldown_window to avoid autoscaler thrash after bursts. Migration strategy persists burst tokens with TTL and rebuilds state on restart. Related: Linear ENG-2129, ENG-3148, support ticket SUP-701. CI: initial lint failed due to a logging import, fixed in follow-up commit, final CI green. Testing: unit tests for token bucket accounting, end-to-end canary against perf-canary with synthetic burst traffic, and manual validation of Console graphs. Merge: squash merge after approvals.

review_comments: Marta Reyes: Nice approach overall. Two concerns: 1) token bucket persistence could cause double-counting on failover, please add an idempotency guard. 2) metrics cardinality may increase drastically if we tag by fleet+region. This needs addressing.

Author (Liam Chen): Added an idempotency token and recovery reconciliation to prevent double-counting; moved high-cardinality tags behind a feature flag and documented the cost in observability notes.
Noah Patel: Please add an opt-out toggle for Console dashboard wiring for enterprise customers that prefer telemetry offloading.
Author (Liam Chen): Added enterprise toggle and defaulted to off for Private deployments.
Evelyn Park: Load tests passed at 3x baseline with sustained_util_target=0.7 and burst_budget=2m tokens. Approving subject to perf-canary validation logs being uploaded.
Author: Uploaded perf-canary run logs to Linear ENG-2129 and addressed minor flakiness in test harness.
release_notes: Adds per-fleet burst_budget and sustained_util_target controls, cooldown_window to reduce autoscaler thrash, persisted burst state with recovery, new telemetry metrics and Console burst utilization dashboard. Backwards-compatible. See docs/designs/dedicated-burst-budget.md for migration notes.
